All-New 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid Just Went on Sale in the US and Already Got a CGI Midnight Edition
22 photos
Photo: AutoYa / YouTube
Nissan’s “smoothest, quietest and quickest Rogue ever” arrived at United States dealerships at the end of October, and is getting ready to make its public debut at the Los Angeles Auto Show between November 20 and 29. But someone thought that since Nissan timed the release with Halloween, they should have also cooked an all-black Midnight Edition for the occasion, too.
The Japanese automaker is selling two different versions of its popular Rogue nameplate – the regular compact crossover SUV is still stuck on the T33 tier for the 2027 model year, but its Rogue Hybrid sibling has already made the switch to the T34 fourth edition lifestyle for the 2027MY. Nissan has announced that their all-new 2027 Rogue Hybrid went on sale in the United States on October 30, just a day prior to Halloween 2026.
“Rogue Hybrid is the next step in Nissan’s U.S. growth story. We set out to build the best hybrid to grow the brand, and Rogue Hybrid delivers with the efficiency, performance and refinement customers want,” said Tiago Castro, senior vice president, U.S. Marketing & Sales, Nissan and Infiniti. The model has a fuel economy of EPA-estimated 38 mpg combined, and it’s powered by the unconventional e-Power system, which, unlike conventional hybrids, uses the gasoline engine solely as a generator while the wheels are always driven by the dual electric motors.
Unlike the regular, older 2027 Nissan Rogue, which is available in S, SV, Dark Armor, Rock Creek, and Platinum grades, the all-new 2027 Rogue Hybrid only has three versions to show off: SV, SR, and Platinum. Actually, the new model only launches with the all-wheel-drive SR with the SR Technology Package, with the full model range set to become available in early 2027.
No worries, as those who seek more options have a solution thanks to the rumor mill and the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI. More precisely, good folks over at the " AutoYa " info channel on YouTube have unofficially imagined the CGI look of the all-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid with Midnight attire – since the Japanese automaker’s local division launched the model on the eve of Halloween 2026.
Well, coincidence or not, the host of the channel says that we can check the all-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid’s trim and color options in the official online configurator after it was officially launched in the US market, but they still decided to preview it with the “most stylish” black package – known as Midnight Edition.
The channel’s resident virtual artist took care of all the illustrations, of course, and besides the all-black version, they also cooked up the virtual Midnight Edition with a series of other darkened colors mixed with black accents inside and outside. So, what do you think?
